# kcore_snapshot_policy (Resource)

Snapshot schedule (`kctl create snapshot-policy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_snapshot_policy" "daily" {
  name            = "daily"
  selector_volume = kcore_volume.data.name
  schedule        = "@daily"
  keep            = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keep` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `schedule` (String) @hourly, @daily, or every:<seconds>

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `selector_vm` (String)
- `selector_volume` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_message` (String)
